account: Today I kept my morning office hours, walked the plaza market, had lunch at home, and returned to the office for my thirteen hundred town accounts. The unusual business is the builder's repeated attempts to speak with Freight. At about 09:48 I heard the builder shout, “Freight, please wait! I need a private word.” I also heard distant shouting from Freight, but could not understand it. Around 12:48 I heard the builder talking and shouting again without making out the words. I do not know what their business is or whether it is urgent; it may simply be a private work matter. I asked the secretary to inquire with them and report back, but have not yet received her findings. Several townsfolk reported that the baker was carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery. That seems consistent with baking supplies, and I have no evidence of anything improper or unusual about it. The secretary secured a copy of my appointments in the office chest and said she retained the original. My three o'clock appointment is tea with a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank, but the exact host and cottage remain unconfirmed; I asked her to establish those details too. The appointments chest currently contains one written book. I have not read any new report from it.
